Name: cantibleChaos's BFAV Oxen for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from cantibleChaos, I have converted their BFAV Oxen (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9647) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to cantibleChaos for the original mod. 

Oxen live in Barns and produce Ox Tails and hardwood.

Enjoy!
